_notes: Scaled setup: a trace-driven simulator of one Qwen3-14B/H20-class node replaces the paper's vLLM deployment; workloads are sampled from the paper's QwenTrace head segment (first 2500 text requests of the Qwen-Bailian trace A). Goodput gains are measured against evaluator-owned copies of the two baselines. Paper numbers kept under keys starting with '_' are on the paper's own scale (Table 3 is a geometric mean over four models) and are context, not targets. Weights: single-node peak goodput is the paper's headline claim (0.5); the Table 4 latency detail (TTFT tail reduction while keeping TPOT) and the Table 5 SLO-versatility row share the rest.

qwen_peak_goodput.description: Single-node peak goodput on QwenTrace (TTFT 500 ms / TPOT 50 ms): effective RPS swept over offered loads 1.0-5.0 RPS, as in Figure 5 / Table 3.
qwen_peak_goodput.notes: Gains are relative to the better of the evaluator's frozen vLLM-vanilla and vLLM-sarathi at the same instances. The paper reports +23.8% (FairBatching-vanilla) and +109% (FairBatching-PAB) over vLLM-vanilla on QwenTrace (Table 3, Section 5.2).

peak_goodput_gain_pct.description: Peak over the load sweep of effective RPS (offered RPS x fraction of requests meeting both SLOs; rejected requests fail), as % gain over the best evaluator baseline.

mean_goodput_gain_pct.description: Mean effective RPS over all sweep loads (rewards graceful overload), as % gain over the best evaluator baseline.

qwen_latency_detail.description: Latency detail at 2.5 RPS on QwenTrace (TTFT 500 ms / TPOT 50 ms), the Table 4 operating point (Qwen3-14B, RPS=2.5).
qwen_latency_detail.notes: Latencies are over admitted requests (rejected ones excluded, as in Table 4); an admitted request that never completes counts at 20x the SLO. TPOT of a request is its worst per-token rate measured from the later of its first token and its TTFT deadline, the quantity whose Table 4 values (FB 50/50, Sarathi 46/49 at p95/p99) the paper reports. If SLO attainment falls below the weakest evaluator baseline, every metric of this experiment takes its worst value.

ttft_p99_ms.description: P99 time to first token over admitted requests (ms).

slo_attainment.description: Fraction of all offered requests (rejections included) that meet both the TTFT and the per-token deadline SLO.

tpot_p99_ms.description: P99 over admitted requests of the worst per-token output rate (ms/token).

ttft_p50_ms.description: Median time to first token over admitted requests (ms).

qwen_relaxed_slo_goodput.description: SLO versatility (Table 5 row TTFT 1000 ms / TPOT 100 ms): peak goodput gain on QwenTrace swept over offered loads 1.5-6.0 RPS.
qwen_relaxed_slo_goodput.notes: Table 5 reports peak-goodput improvement over the better of vLLM-sarathi and vLLM-vanilla; at TTFT=1000/TPOT=100 the paper reports +8.1% (FairBatching-vanilla) and +64.9% (FairBatching-PAB).

peak_goodput_gain_pct.description: Peak over the load sweep of effective RPS, as % gain over the best evaluator baseline.

mean_goodput_gain_pct.description: Mean effective RPS over all sweep loads, as % gain over the best evaluator baseline.
